name: Paperspace (DigitalOcean) Core GPU Pricing - Hourly dedicated GPU rates
notes: Fetched 2026-10-04. Now branded as DigitalOcean. Gradient platform pricing: Free tier ($0/month + utilization costs on paid instances), Pro ($8/month), Growth ($39/month). Compute billed per hour outside free tier. On-Demand dedicated GPU rates (per hour, per instance including vCPU+RAM): H100 $3.09/hr (newly available, 90GB RAM, 12 vCPU); A100 $2.24/hr (90GB RAM, 12 vCPU); A100-80G $1.15/hr (90GB RAM, 12 vCPU); A4000 $0.76/hr (45GB RAM, 8 vCPU); A6000 $1.89/hr (45GB RAM, 8 vCPU); V100 $2.30/hr (16GB GPU, 30GB RAM, 8 vCPU); A5000 $1.38/hr (45GB RAM, 8 vCPU); P6000 $1.10/hr (24GB GPU, 30GB RAM, 8 vCPU); RTX5000 $0.82/hr (30GB RAM, 8 vCPU); RTX4000 $0.56/hr (30GB RAM, 8 vCPU); P4000 $0.51/hr (8GB GPU, 30GB RAM, 8 vCPU); M4000 $0.45/hr (8GB GPU, 30GB RAM, 8 vCPU). Multi-GPU types available for A100-80G (8x), A4000 (2x/4x), A6000 (2x/4x), V100 (2x/4x), A5000 (2x/4x), P6000 (2x/4x), RTX5000 (2x/4x), RTX4000 (2x/4x), P4000 (2x/4x). Auto-shutdown on all paid tiers (12h limit on Free, configurable on Pro/Growth). Storage $0.29/GB overage. Note: Paperspace/A100-80G at $1.15/hr is one of the cheapest datacenter GPU rates published, but this is the 'A100-80G' variant (likely A100 PCIe) not the SXM version.
